description: This file defines the class Zend_Http_UserAgent_Spam, which is a part of the Zend Framework's HTTP UserAgent package. The class is used to identify and classify spam user agents based on certain signatures, and provides methods to match user agent strings and determine the type as 'spam'. It extends an abstract device class, indicating it is a specific implementation related to HTTP user agent detection.

classes.name: Zend_Http_UserAgent_Spam
classes.description: A class for detecting spam user agents based on signatures within the Zend Framework's HTTP UserAgent package.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Static method to determine if a user agent string matches spam signatures.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of user agent, which is 'spam' for instances of this class.

methods.name: _defineFeatures
methods.description: Defines features related to spam detection, setting various browser capabilities to false.
